items.title: AI日报
items.mainLine: 今日筛出 1 条 AI 技术信号，优先看 「Gemini Robotics ER 2: powering robotics with video understanding, task orchestration, and multi-robot collaboration」。脉络集中在大模型训练/推理、Agent Skill、Auto-Research/Harness 与可复制工程实践。
actionItems: 评估是否可沉淀到团队 AI Native / Agent 自进化链路：Gemini Robotics ER 2: powering robotics with video understanding, task orchestration, and multi-robot collaboration
watchItems: 跟进：Gemini Robotics ER 2: powering robotics with video understanding, task orchestration, and multi-robot collaboration

items.title: Gemini Robotics ER 2: powering robotics with video understanding, task orchestration, and multi-robot collaboration
items.summary: 这篇内容聚焦「AI 技术演进和可复用工程实践」。原文摘要显示：Gemini Robotics ER 2 helps robots reason, collaborate, and solve real-world tasks. It represents a step change in video understanding, tool orchestration, and multi-robot collaboration for robotic applications.
items.insightText: 先快速判断它是否包含可复用方法、架构或工程经验，再决定是否进入日报深读。
